couplets.en: Let us steal a glance at each other, my love.

lines: Tasavvur mein chale aate ho, kuch baatein bhi hoti hain
couplets.en: You come to me in my thoughts, and we talk a little.
Come up to my balcony, my love.

lines: Prem ki bhiksha maange bhikharan, laaj hamari rakhiyo saajan
couplets.en: I come begging for love, dear heart, spare me the shame.

lines: Aao saajan tum hamare dwaare, saara jhagra khatam hoi jaaye
couplets.en: Come to my door, my love, and let the quarrel end.

lines: Tumhari yaad aansoo ban ke aayi, chashm-e veeraan mein
couplets.en: The thought of you brought tears to my lonely eyes.

lines: Zahe qismat ke veeraanon mein barsaatein bhi hoti hain
couplets.en: What good fortune that rain falls even on barren places.
Come up to my balcony, my love.
Let us steal a glance at each other, my love.
